column1: # Game profile of Kirby and the Forgotten Land (Switch, update 1.1.0 = v65536). Plays on the Mac
# HAL Laboratory's own engine on NintendoWare (G3d, Font, Fxt) and nn::atk2 sound, SDK 11.4.0, NVN; subsdk0 is the movie module (VP9 / Vorbis WebM cinematics and guide movies).
# The shaders are BNSH archives inside HAL's .cmp containers under gfx/, ptcl/ and lyt/, in the loose shader/ files and embedded in main (shader_split.py); no run met a shader missing from the map.
# The game asks for present interval 1 and paces itself (30 fps on the Switch); with the profile's cuts it runs at 60 or 120 (Frame rate below)

# Game name: only a label for profile listings and the Mac window title; the iOS app name is the game name in the base NSP, and the bundle ID comes from the base game title ID (build_ipa.sh / NSP script)
# load order as on Horizon: main, subsdk*, sdk (subsdk0 = NintendoSDK_movie 11.4.0)
# 120 fps where the screen shows it, else 60: the rewriter's cuts put the game's frame pacer in 1/120 s units and keep its step in 1/60 s (patches.py), and the host writes the
# pacer's units a frame (hle_fpslock.c: 1 at 120, 2 at 60) from the hold, which falls to 60 when frames do not fit, on a screen below 120 Hz and, on a Mac, on battery or in Low Power Mode.
# Speed played the same at 60 and 120 (README.md, Frame rate). DM_FPS_TARGET=60 holds 60, 30 holds 30
# The pacer's own wait is cut, so only the host paces and the game measures each frame: on a 100 Hz screen it runs at 100 (docs/reference/frame-rate.md)
# Present snapshots: the game's next frame starts while the last one waits for the screen. Without them its CPU and GPU time added up at 120 (about 2 + 6 ms, plus the
# present, against 8.3) and the hub held 60 for minutes standing still; with them 120 there (README.md, Frame rate)
# The NPDM declares no system resource, so there is no virtual address memory: the game sets a heap of the pool less 64 MB of used memory (3.14 GB, measured), which fits the
# 3.25 GB heap region of this 4 GB block (256 MB in front + 256 MB alias region + 256 MB stack region + heap region). The application pool is the Switch's 3285 MB
# ---- Shader split (shader_split.py; BNSH in HAL's .cmp containers, the loose shader/ files and main) ----
